Question
========
According to the SRTM data, what is the height of Yr Wyddfa (the highest mountain in Eryri)? *(don't use commas)*

##ANSWER1##

According to the SRTM data, what is the height of Pen y Fan (the highest mountain in the Bannau Brycheiniog)? *(don't use commas)*

##ANSWER2##

Solution
========
- The height of Yr Wyddfa was 1,063.
- The height of Pen y Fan was 876.
